# Varnam

Varnam is an ultra-premium, interactive, and cinematic digital wedding invitation platform. It allows users to create bespoke, luxury-tier digital wedding e-invites shareable with a single link on WhatsApp, SMS, or email.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://varnaminvites.store/) - Premium cinematic digital wedding invitations with RSVP tracker.
- [Templates Gallery](https://varnaminvites.store/templates) - Handcrafted templates collection featuring Classic and Premium cinematic digital wedding invitations.
- [Privacy Policy](https://varnaminvites.store/privacy-policy) - Privacy and security guidelines.
- [Terms of Service](https://varnaminvites.store/terms-of-service) - Licensing terms and conditions.

## Key Features

- **Cinematic Entrance Animations**: Lotus archways, temple pillars, heritage doorways, and scratch-to-reveal cards with falling petals.
- **Dynamic RSVP Tracking**: Online RSVP management with attendance logs, guest counts, and guest wish boards.
- **Event Information & Schedules**: Interactive multi-event schedules with dress code specifications, transit instructions, and active directions.
- **Media & Slideshow Integration**: Customized background image uploads, photo slideshow galleries, and support for elegant background music tracks.
- **No App Required**: Built on modern web technologies ensuring compatibility across any mobile and desktop browser.

## Pricing

- [Pricing Details](https://varnaminvites.store/#pricing) - Transparent event licensing: Classic tier at ₹999, Premium tier at ₹1,199. Free drafting and preview, pay only to activate your live link.

## Templates Collection

1. [Kamalam Kalyanam](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/kamalam-kalyanam) - Minimalist royal crimson wedding invitation framed with golden lotus archway, elegant typography, and smooth scroll motion.
2. [Kovil Thirumanam](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/kovil-thirumanam) - Grand temple wedding invitation featuring carved stone architecture, sacred oil lamps, and cinematic gold foil reveal.
3. [Kalyana Mandapam](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/kalyana-mandapam) - Palace mandapam wedding invitation with carved heritage pillars, traditional scroll timeline, and gold filigree animations.
4. [Konaseema Kalyanam](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/konaseema-kalyanam) - River heritage wedding invitation featuring ancestral wooden doorway reveal, brass deepams, and festive courtyard celebration.
5. [Theertha Mandapam](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/theertha-mandapam) - Serene sacred water wedding invitation adorned with royal swans, floating lotus blossoms, and traditional hanging bells.
6. [Marigold Vizha](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/marigold-vizha) - Joyous celebration adorned with cascading marigold garlands, peacock archway motifs, and glowing terracotta lamps.
7. [Mangala Isai](https://varnaminvites.store/templates/kadhal-editorial) - Graceful classical wedding invitation adorned with royal gold filigree archway, divine Veena and Mridangam melodies.
